<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.SumDownStream: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Sums the values of a map downstream, along the drainage directions: each cell gets the sum of the values of the cells upstream of it, itself included. The values outside the thresholds are not summed, and stop the paths.

**Toolbox folder:** Statistics<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Statistics, Downstream, Drainage directions<br>
**Authors:** Daniele Andreis, Antonello Andrea, Erica Ghesla, Cozzini Andrea, Franceschi Silvia, Pisoni Silvano, Rigon Riccardo<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.SumDownStream`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions. |
| `inToSum` | raster file |  |  | The map of the values to sum. |
| `pUpperThres` | Double |  |  | The value from which the values are not summed. |
| `pLowerThres` | Double |  |  | The value up to which the values are not summed. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outSummed` | output file |  | The map of the sums of the values upstream. |
